title: Bus crashes in Sogod; several passengers suffer injuries
summary: A passenger bus operated by Vallacar Transit veered off the road and crashed into a rocky hillside in Barangay Liki, Sogod, northern Cebu, around 8 a.m. on Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026. ... Keep on…
